name: Kane CLI by TestMu AI
tagline: Verify any browser flow from your terminal in natural language
description: Kane CLI by TestMu AI is a deterministic browser agent for developers, AI coding agents and CI/CD pipelines. This skill teaches the agent to use it for any task that needs a real browser: describe a flow in natural language and kane-cli drives real Chrome, returning a pass or fail with a replayable .evidence pack and typed exit codes (0 pass, 1 fail, 2 auth or setup error, 3 timeout). It also covers agent mode with NDJSON output, designing requirement-linked test suites from a PRD or spec, and native Android or iOS app tests on an emulator or simulator. Requires the kane-cli CLI (npm install -g @testmuai/kane-cli, with Node.js 18+ and Google Chrome) and a TestMu AI account.

install.notes: The skill is not the CLI, so install kane-cli as well and run kane-cli login once.
